title: Sequences and assemblies of 18 lichen metagenomes
description: Sequences and assemblies of 18 lichen metagenomes: Cladonia chlorophaea, Cladonia imbricarica, Cladonia rangiferina, Diploschistes muscorum, Lepraria finkii, Lepraria lanata, Lepraria normandinoides, Lepraria oxybapha, Pseudocyphellaria citrina, Pseucyphellaria rainierensis, Punctelia appalachensis, Punctelia rudecta, Sticta beauvoisii, Sticta deyana, Sulcaria isidiifera, Usnea strigosa, and Usnea subfusca. These genomes were used for comparative genomics and population genomics study.
samples: MIMAG Metagenome-assembled Genome sample from Cladonia rangiferina

USA: Washington State, Chelan County, Leavenworth, Wenatchee Nat Forest, Roadside of NF-6701 past intersection with NF-6700, between the bridge over Rainy Creek and other river further along the road.
